answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The thread lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vine is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
